name: ad-motion-video
description: Make vertical feed video ads (1080x1920, 25-35 s): digital-human hook and price shots around code-rendered middle pages, in a four-page structure (value-contrast hook, install/usage steps, selling-point wall, price). Includes reference-video beat/motion analysis, a 40-style library for re-skinning, same-account similarity pre-checks and technical QA. Private rules live in an untracked local/ folder. Adapted from motion-showreel (MIT).
